summary: Iteration 219 - Batch 6 (FINAL) Keyless Competitor Parity Features tested. All 5 new P0 features working: (1) Pre-Authorization Holds, (2) Chargeback Defense Package, (3) PWA Web Push Notifications, (4) PMS-CRS Two-way Sync, (5) Public API Sandbox/Developer Portal. Backend: 49/49 tests passed. Frontend: All 5 new panels render correctly with proper data-testid attributes.
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 Batch 6 features implemented correctly with proper state machines and validation
Pre-Auth Holds: State machine enforced (cannot capture released hold, capture <= authorized amount, second hold supersedes first)
Chargeback Defense: Evidence builder auto-compiles from 9 sources with scoring and narrative generation
Web Push: Simulated delivery mode when VAPID not configured, with pending queue for PWA polling
PMS-CRS Sync: Hash-based change detection, bidirectional sync with conflict detection
Public API: Proper key issuance (hk_ prefix), scope enforcement, property_id validation, rate limiting (429)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing default property with 99 seeded bookings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 219 completes Batch 6 (FINAL batch) of 30 P0 keyless competitor-parity features. All 30 P0 features are now implemented. Features tested: (1) Pre-Auth Holds at /api/preauth/* - card hold ledger with state machine (authorized→captured|released|expired), supersede logic for same booking. (2) Chargeback Defense at /api/chargebacks/* - evidence builder from 9 sources (booking, folio, payments, preauth, lock events, comms, reg cards, ID docs, surveys) with scoring and narrative. (3) Web Push at /api/push/* - browser subscriptions with simulated delivery when VAPID not configured. (4) PMS-CRS Sync at /api/pms-crs/* - internal CRS index with hash-based change detection, bidirectional sync, conflict detection. (5) Public API at /api/developer/* - API key issuance (hk_ prefix), scope enforcement, property_id validation, rate limiting. Frontend panels: PreAuthPanel, ChargebackPanel, WebPushPanel, PmsCrsSyncPanel, PublicApiPortalPanel. Sidebar buttons: preauth-btn, chargeback-btn, web-push-btn, pms-crs-btn, public-api-btn.

state_machine.second_hold_supersedes: VERIFIED - first hold marked released with notes_release=superseded

endpoints.build_evidence: GET /api/chargebacks/case/{case_id}/evidence - auto-builds manifest with checks dict + score + narrative

delivery_modes.simulated: When property has no web_push_vapid keys - uses pending queue
delivery_modes.real_vapid: When VAPID keys configured - actual HTTPS POST

endpoints.push: POST /api/pms-crs/sync/push - PMS→CRS with hash tracking, returns created/updated/unchanged

sandbox_endpoints.availability: GET /api/developer/sandbox/availability - requires read:availability scope + property_id match

mocked_apis.web_push_delivery: Simulated when property has no web_push_vapid keys - falls back to in-app pending queue
mocked_apis.preauth_stripe_capture: Ledger-only, no live card auth - state machine tracks authorized/captured/released/expired
